item.desc: This might be the craziest city in China 🤯🇨🇳 Welcome to Chongqing — one of the most futuristic cities on Earth. Here, buildings seem to float on water, trains pass through apartment complexes, and gas stations sit on rooftops like it’s normal. The subway goes 90 meters underground — as deep as a 31-storey building. The road networks feel like a maze, where one wrong turn can cost you hours. And the wildest part? What looks like the ground floor might actually be the 22nd floor. This city completely breaks your sense of reality 😮 What do you think — genius or chaos? 🌍✨   #Chongqing #ChinaFacts #WorldFacts #china #yallaboost

item.desc: Somehow we’ve become so used to delayed trains, broken infrastructure, cash payments, paperwork, and inefficient public services that when a country gets these basics right, we call it “the future.” The future isn’t digital payments or high-speed rail. It’s the present.  While China is getting all those things right and more, we are stuck with fighting each other over petty topics.  That’s what the present is supposed to look like - clean cities, efficient public transport, systems are work for the people.  After travelling through China, I realised that what people call “living in 2050” is just the result of decades of investment in infrastructure and public services. Whether you agree with China’s political system or not, it’s hard not to notice what can happen when development becomes a national priority. Maybe China isn’t ahead of everyone else. Maybe the rest of us have just accepted less than we should. #china #china2050 #chinatravel #travelinchina #solotraveller

That’s what the present is supposed to look like - clean cities, efficient public transport, systems are work for the people.
After travelling through China, I realised that what people call “living in 2050” is just the result of decades of investment in infrastructure and public services.
Whether you agree with China’s political system or not, it’s hard not to notice what can happen when development becomes a national priority.
Maybe China isn’t ahead of everyone else.
Maybe the rest of us have just accepted less than we should.
#china #china2050 #chinatravel #travelinchina #solotraveller
